admin.cache_enabled_help: Check out the Information page on how to test the cache. NOTE: When disabling the cache, all cached entries for this site will be purged.
admin.public_cache_ttl_help: Define how long, in seconds, public pages should be cached. The default value is 604800 seconds (one week).
admin.clearing_cache_listener_label: Purge LSCache When Flarum Cache is Cleared
admin.clearing_cache_listener_help: Disabling this avoids rebuilding the page cache after minor asset changes. Cached pages can load rebuilt assets from the same URLs, while a CDN such as Cloudflare may continue serving older versions from its cache. Page settings and extension data may also remain outdated. With this option disabled, purge LSCache manually after major updates or extension changes.
admin.serve_stale_help: When cached content is purged, allow LiteSpeed to serve the previous cached version while generating a fresh copy. This reduces server load, but visitors may temporarily see outdated content. If disabled, visitors must wait for a fresh page.
admin.purge_on_discussion_update_label: Purge URLs or cache Tags on Discussion Update
admin.purge_on_discussion_update_help: Enter the URLs or cache Tags you want to purge when a discussion is updated, one per line. URL should start with /, e.g. /rankings, and cache Tag should start with tag=, e.g. tag=rankings. For multiple routes, adding a rule in .htaccess with a regular expression that tags routes and entering only this tag here is faster. Learn more. By default, the cache for the homepage and updated discussions is purged.
admin.cache_exclude_help: Enter one regular expression per line. /private matches any path containing /private; ^/private$ matches only /private. Query strings are ignored. Existing cached pages remain available until they expire or you purge them. To apply exclusions immediately, purge the affected URLs via CLI or purge all LSCache entries from the admin cache menu.
admin.drop_qs_help:
Enter query parameter names to ignore when caching, one per line, for example fbclid or utm*. URLs that differ only in these parameters share the same cached page. Only ignore parameters that do not change page content. Requires LSWS v5.2.3 or newer. Learn more about dropping query strings.

⚠️ This setting will modify the .htaccess file.
admin.status_codes_cache_label: Default HTTP Status Code Page TTL
admin.status_codes_cache_help: Specify an HTTP status code and the number of seconds to cache that page, separated by a space. One per line.
admin.test_failed_alert: It looks like your server does not support LSCache. Check your server configuration. Detected server: {server}, detected LiteSpeed type: {type}.

purge_modal.title: => acpl-lscache.ref.purge_cache
purge_modal.paths_help: Enter one URL or path per line, for example {url}/t/general or /t/general.
purge_modal.tags_help: Enter one LSCache tag per line, for example discussion_123 or discussions.

lib.purge_success: Notified LiteSpeed Server to purge LSCache entries.
lib.purge_all_success: Notified LiteSpeed Server to purge all LSCache entries.
